relations: The curved wooden domino line sits beside the marble track, so triggering one row may initiate a sequential collapse along the curve.
The elevated red bowls on the blue structure are positioned above the track, so releasing an object there causes it to roll downward.
The vast field of colorful dominoes is separated from the main track, meaning a collapse in one area does not automatically affect the other.
The tripod-mounted camera is positioned to the side, maintaining a clear line of sight to the dominoes without blocking their path.
